notes: Sequential runs on a shared host, 3 trials; throughput figures are short synthetic echo results, not business capacity.
I/O simulation uses Tokio sleep(1ms); CPU simulation uses a 20ms wall-clock busy loop.
The isolated variant is a host-side reference using spawn_blocking plus a 2-slot Semaphore; it is not a new framework CPU executor.
Request latency samples are capped at the first 100000 per client.
No production code changes were made for this assessment.
CPU saturation probe has four concurrent 100ms busy jobs and a barrier; protected variant uses four blocking workers for equal CPU concurrency.
DHAT runs use 8000 successful requests; allocation counts include application and Tokio overhead; wall times under Valgrind are not performance data.

Archived probe source/binary include the later saturation case. Routing, observation and mixed runs used the same corresponding functions before that case was added; the pre-saturation source digest is recorded, but its binary was not retained.
